problems.title: Student Management Mini Project
problems.description: Develop a mini Student Management System using Java and JDBC with CRUD operations.
problems.code:
Features:
1. Add Student
2. View Students
3. Update Student
4. Delete Student
5. Search Student

Technology Used:
- Java
- JDBC
- MySQL
- PreparedStatement
- ResultSet

Database Table:
student(id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(50), marks DOUBLE)
problems.output: A complete console-based Student Management System supporting Create, Read, Update, Delete, and Search operations.
